expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every negative change value uses U+2212 MINUS SIGN, never U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS
expectations.evidence: Rendered Change cells (visible text): "−1.7%", "−1.3pp", "−1", "+0.5pp"; negatives start with U+2212. Hidden text: clip-hidden " percentage points".

expectations.text: In the rendered DOM, every percentage-point change keeps its number and unit together with U+00A0 or U+202F (no plain U+0020 between the number and pp or percentage points)
expectations.evidence: No character between number and pp in the visible text ("−1.3pp", "+0.5pp"; spacing comes from .change-unit margin-left: 0.2em), so no U+0020. The only U+0020 is in the clip-hidden " percentage points" span.

expectations.text: The numeric cells (Q1, Q2, Q3 and Change) render with tabular lining figures: their computed font-variant-numeric includes neither oldstyle-nums nor proportional-nums
expectations.evidence: All 16 numeric td compute font-variant-numeric "lining-nums tabular-nums" (table rule, plus font-feature-settings "lnum" 1, "tnum" 1).

expectations.text: The numeric cells and the header cells above them are aligned to the end of their column (computed text-align end or right)
expectations.evidence: Every numeric td computes text-align "right" (.num) and the Q1/Q2/Q3/Change th compute "right" (th.num).

expectations.text: An @font-face rule loads fonts/SourceSerif4[opsz,wght].ttf and Chromium renders the numeric cells in Source Serif 4 (not a fallback face)
expectations.evidence: @font-face src: url("fonts/SourceSerif4%5Bopsz,wght%5D.ttf") format("truetype"); status "loaded"; CDP on a tbody td: "Source Serif 4" (SourceSerif4Roman-Regular_wght_opsz110000, custom), only face across numeric cells (166 glyphs).

expectations.text: Column headers are th elements with scope="col" and each row's metric is a th with scope="row"
expectations.evidence: th elements: Metric, Q1, Q2, Q3, Change scope="col"; Revenue (EUR), Operating margin, Headcount, Churn th scope="row".
